name: Walk With Me VR
summary:
Walk With Me VR transforms the way you experience immersive videos.

Enjoy high-quality VR videos while staying connected to your real-world surroundings. A passthrough view at the bottom of the display lets you see the ground and your feet, helping you stay aware of your environment while remaining immersed in your content.

Choose how you want to watch:

Stream immersive videos from the online library (subscription required)
Play your own VR videos directly from a connected USB storage device
